faqs.question: Should I use 💭❓ in a work email?
faqs.answer: Skip 💭❓ in work emails. Sarcasm-coded emojis are too easily misread in long-form professional communication.

faqs.question: What does 💭❓ mean?
faqs.answer: 💭❓ is a sarcasm-coded combo. The two emojis pair to make the read unmistakably ironic — the sender is signaling that whatever they said is meant to be taken sideways.

faqs.question: Does 💭❓ work in family groups?
faqs.answer: In family groups 💭❓ works best when the family already uses sarcasm as love-coded banter. Otherwise it tends to misread.

faqs.question: Is 💭❓ an insult?
faqs.answer: 💭❓ is not a direct insult. The sarcasm-coded cue is a soft tease; if it lands as an insult, the sender usually wrote the lead-up that way.
